properties.name: The roads not taken are preserved and forkable
properties.statement: reflow2 preserves not only what was decided but what was considered and rejected: every Decision keeps its unchosen alternatives as first-class, forkable siblings, and any past decision can be re-opened at its epoch and a different branch taken from that point. The design is a navigable decision tree, not only a linear history — the extension of req:intent-preserved from 'the past is never overwritten' to 'the roads not taken are never lost either.' The unchosen option and its rationale are stored; the alternative's consequence design is computed on demand by replay, never eagerly maintained.
